title: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.17808v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents can coordinate tools and applications to complete complex, multi-step tasks. As their interaction histories grow, effective context management becomes essential for reliable and efficient execution. Existing methods reduce context through summarization, pruning, or history selection. However, shorter contexts do not necessarily support better decisions: summaries can omit exact details needed for later actions, while retaining entire interactions can carry substantial irrelevant information. We propose CarryOn, a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence. A learned selector and adaptive retention policy keep relevant evidence available without additional LLM calls for context management. translated_title: CarryOn：为长程LLM智能体学习在上下文中保留什么
translated_abstract: 长程LLM智能体能够协调工具和应用程序以完成复杂的多步骤任务。随着交互历史的增长，有效的上下文管理对于可靠且高效的执行变得至关重要。现有方法通过摘要、剪枝或历史选择来缩减上下文。然而，更短的上下文并不一定支持更好的决策：摘要可能省略后续操作所需的精确细节，而保留完整的交互则会携带大量无关信息。我们提出了CarryOn，一个轻量级的上下文管理器，它将紧凑的执行状态与细粒度的、带有来源链接的证据相结合。一个经过学习的选择器和自适应保留策略能够保持相关证据的可用性，而无需额外的LLM调用来进行上下文管理。我们引入了两个互补的评估指标：$S_\alpha$在考虑资源使用的同时优先考虑任务成功率，而每次成功的归一化成本（NCS）用于衡量……
tldr: CarryOn是一个轻量级上下文管理器，通过学习的选择器和自适应保留策略，将紧凑的执行状态与细粒度的来源链接证据相结合，无需额外LLM调用即可为长程LLM智能体实现可靠的上下文管理。
en_tdlr: CarryOn is a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence, using a learned selector and adaptive retention policy to enable reliable context management for long-horizon LLM agents without additional LLM calls.
